notes: Chaining trampoline bounces at the player's own pace to reach higher platforms is Obby & Platformer, and the jump heights have to be physics-legal for a combo to land anywhere, so the genre-wide P6 stands. This is not the Simulation stat-grinder family: the bounce multiplier resets on the ground, so nothing is a persistent stat behind a purchase wall. I took volume-open-air from outside the genre's typical course shapes because the play space really is the air - a few thousand studs of pastel skyscape with trampolines below and floating platforms and stars above - which none of course-flat, course-terraced or course-tower describes; that adds CHECK for a volume that may self-occlude at those heights. Kept the Precision Platformer preset for its skilled-movement option set (obstacle-jump covers the trampoline boosts, path-shortcut the tighter combo lines to the high rewards) but dropped obstacle-moving, since nothing in a chill pastel bounce world asks for rotating or swinging hazards, and with no user to ask I read the best appearance-changing power-ups at the top of the climb as the winner-zone payoff rather than adding checkpoints to a course that has no start or finish.
